NEWS UPDATE | The Quezon City Government continues to inspect flood control projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways in the city.

Based on several residents' statements, flooding has worsened in some of the areas where flood control projects have been built.

The local government will also review the scope of work of the projects, to ensure the quality of the infrastructure and determine if it is in accordance with the contract. | via Rio Araja

data.raw_text:
In view of the Installation of the Khairtabad Bada Ganesh, every day from   27-08-2025 to 06-09-2025 the following traffic diversions will be done on need basis from 1100 hours to till late in the night, depending on the visitors coming to have a darshan of Khairatabad #BadaGanesh.

1. The general traffic coming from VV Statue towards Mint Compound via, Rajeev Gandhi Statue will not be allowed and diverted at Rajeev Gandhi Statue towards Nirankari Junction.

2. The general traffic coming from Old PS Saifabad towards Bada Ganesh via. Rajdoot lane will not be allowed and diverted at Rajdoot lane towards Iqbal Minar.

3. The general traffic coming from Iqbal Minar towards IMAX Theatre via. Mint Compound will not be allowed and diverted at Secretariat Temple X Road towards Telugu Thalli junction.

4. The general traffic coming from Necklace Rotary towards Mint Compound will not be allowed and diverted at Necklace Rotary towards Telugu Thalli junction or Khairatabad fly over.

5. The general traffic coming from Nirankari via. Khairatabad Post Office lane towards Khairatabad Railway gate will not be allowed and diverted at Post Office towards Old PS Saifabad junction.

6. Expected Traffic Congestion:
Due to large number of devotees visiting Bada Ganesh, traffic congestion is expected in the following junction’s viz., Khairtabad, Shadan College, Nirankari, Old PS Saifabad, Mint Compound, and Necklace Rotary.  Hence, the commuters are requested to avoid these routes.

7. Parking Places:

a) Visitors coming for Bada Ganesh darshan through Necklace Rotary and NTR Garden should park their vehicles at 1) Race Road, 2) NTR Ghat, 3) HMDA Parking beside IMAX Theatre, 4) Open Place Opp. I-Max Theatre, 5) Saraswathi Vidya Mandir High School premises, Opp. I-Max Theatre.

b) Visitors coming from Bada Ganesh darshan through the Khairatabad Jn. should park their vehicles at Vishveshwaraiah Bhavan.

Further, it is inform that the above restrictions will be imposed depending on the number of devotees coming to have darshan of Khairtabad Bada Ganesh Idol.
The commuters visiting the Khairatabad Bada Ganesh Idol for darshan are requested to use public transport such as Metro Rail, MMTS, and RTC buses. If multiple persons from the same colony are coming to visit the Khairatabad Ganesh Idol, they are advised to opt for carpooling instead of using individual personal vehicles to avoid traffic congestion.

The commuters are requested to avoid above junctions and take alternative routes to reach their destinations to avoid traffic congestion. In case of any emergency during travel, the commuters are requested to call our traffic help line 9010203626 for travel assistance.  All commuters are requested to follow the above traffic advisory and cooperate with the traffic police.
(D. Joel Davis, IPS.,)
Jt. Commissioner of Police,
Traffic, Hyderabad.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 5 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Low Pressure Area (LPA)
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 26 August 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Rizal, Cavite and Metro Manila within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Laguna and Batangas which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
